Swagger._Comment: Swagger UI/JSON is always on in Development. Set Enabled=true (env var Swagger__Enabled) to expose it in another environment — leave false in production unless the docs are meant to be public.

ConnectionStrings._Comment: Populated in the database phase. Never commit a real connection string here — use appsettings.Development.json (gitignored) or user-secrets/environment variables.

EmailSettings._Comment: SenderPassword must NOT be set here. If SmtpHost/SenderEmail/SenderPassword are not all set, emails are only logged to the console. Set EmailSettings__SenderPassword as an environment variable or user-secret.

Paymob._Comment: ApiKey/PublicKey/HmacSecret must NOT be set here — use user-secrets or environment variables (Paymob__ApiKey, ...). Not used until the Payments phase.

Jwt._Comment: Issuer/Audience/expirations are fine to commit. SigningKey must NOT be set here — set it via 'dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:SigningKey" "<a-random-32+-byte-string>"' from Rentify.API, or as an environment variable (Jwt__SigningKey) in real environments.
